answer: The Knoll Drain Protocol makes each new identity absorb the knoll, a non-recoverable minimum balance, from its parent before it can transact. Every clone must echo the parent's last 200 micro-transactions to the shared ledger before its first transaction clears. The terrace of all siblings splits that gas cost, so the attacker's 41st clone pays more in dilution than it earns, making it negative EV.
